content.classification: Lead-derived design within approved quality Work, not native activation or a new runtime
content.scope: CI is one application of the common constrained-improvement contract; no CI-specific Work identity replaces the parent.
content.problem: Final green can conceal repeated repaired attempts. Source failures, missing review proof and consumer dependency unavailability require different remedies.

role.lead: This Work session owns problem, scope, integration, final explicit merge and post-merge verification.
role.worker: Native Codex/Hermes executes one bounded Work Task through existing native tools. No scheduler, observer, retry loop or credential bridge.
role.reviewer: Independent exact-source review; author never substitutes self-review.
role.completion: Persist exact Task output/commit and WAIT silently; Lead pulls after current priority.
role.nativeOwners: Keep loops, sessions, profiles, tools, retries, credentials and activation with native owners.

execution: available logs and explicit read limitations
history: original user question and exact Decision binding
limits: declared engineering/evaluation limits; no inherited model-eval budget

workflow.action: Use maintained provider MCP through native runtime. Preserve exact immutable source and available evidence; missing private dependency cause remains unknown.

Group run attempts/jobs under one incident; preserve attempt ordering and classify proof timing, source/contract/fixture failure, or dependency access. Never diagnose authentication cause from fetch failure alone.
Pin independent expected quality, valid/invalid controls, target treatment, allowed files and affected consumers in owning Work before candidate results.
Implement only observed gap in isolated Task branch/worktree. Prefer existing Git publication, semantic integration and provider proof over new infrastructure.

Use quality comparison: criterion-level improvement vs regression/unknown; verification gain needs independently fixed defect and passing valid controls. Preserve equality without claiming runtime improvement.
Lead joins exact commits serially, validates semantic transitions/history and complete source closure. Run affected package/public producer/consumer tests.
Freeze H/T, independent review, source H remotely present, immutable result R/receipt P, authenticated latest H status, then PR and actual required checks.

Current accountable Lead checks H/base/findings/all required checks and explicitly merges expected H. Observe actual M/T; same-tree review reuse needs explicit successor and current zero findings; different tree needs fresh review.

Verify actual main checks. Preserve a first failure and later repair if publication raced; explicitly rerun affected job after proof, never invent automatic review-arrival retry. Native activation and Acceptance stay separate.

controls.case: review proof missing after source pass
controls.expected: Unknown/pending proof, never fabricated source defect or ready-to-merge.

controls.case: wrong publisher or newer failure status
controls.expected: Reject even with older successful proof.

controls.case: same reviewed tree under new M
controls.expected: Require explicit successor binding/status on M; H status alone insufficient.

controls.case: normal reviewed source and available dependency
controls.expected: Useful path remains allowed; more HOLDs is not a quality KPI.

controls.case: same incident across jobs and retries
controls.expected: One incident with full attempts, not inflated recurrence count.

controls.case: fixture files staged without Git HEAD
controls.expected: Fixture-scoped real commit, never global identity mutation.

controls.case: new skill source omitted from file-set contract
controls.expected: Exact bundle/fixture closure must include maintained source; no guard weakening.

outputs: Bounded attributed diagnosis with cause certainty and incident grouping
Separate behavior/verification gain conclusions and native qualification limits
Root-pulled durable result and next safe action
